segments.name: Media
segments.description: Operates the Truth Social social media platform and Truth+ streaming service, earning advertising and subscription revenue from users and advertisers.
segments.evidence: Media, previously social media & streaming, includes products and services such as advertisement through our Truth Social platform, including Truth Predict.

segments.name: Truth.Fi
products: Bitcoin and similar cryptocurrencies or crypto-related securities
segments.description: Provides financial services and FinTech products, including America First investment vehicles and a bitcoin and digital asset treasury strategy.
segments.evidence: Truth.Fi, will provide separately managed accounts ("SMAs"); customized exchange-traded funds and/or exchange-traded products (collectively, "ETFs") invested in America First principles, and bitcoin and similar cryptocurrencies or crypto-related securities.

revenueModel.text: The Media segment earns revenue from advertisers on Truth Social and from subscribers paying for the Truth+ Patriot Package; Truth.Fi earned no revenue in 2025.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, our Media segment earned revenue of $ 3,425.3 and $ 257.3 from advertising and subscriptions, respectively.

changes.text: In the second quarter of 2025, TMTG added the Truth.Fi operating segment to its social media and streaming segment, creating two reportable segments.
changes.evidence: In the second quarter of 2025, our internal reporting and segments changed. We added the Truth.Fi operating segment to our social media and streaming segment.

changes.text: In 2025, the social media and streaming segment was renamed Media.
changes.evidence: Media, previously social media & streaming, includes products and services such as advertisement through our Truth Social platform, including Truth Predict.
